I was backing out of a parking space at a shopping center in Houston, Texas, moving slowly with my mirrors checked,
when the rear corner of my car struck the side of a pickup that was pulling through the lane behind me. The impact
was low but enough to jolt me forward against the steering wheel. My left wrist hurt right away, and by the time I
reached urgent care it was swollen and I was told it was fractured. I have given the same description of what
happened every time I have spoken abuot it, whether to the other driver, the police officer who responded, the
adjuster, or my doctor. I am listed on the policy of the person who owns this vehicle, and I live in the same household
with them, so I am submitting this claim as a covered household member. I have kept copies of my medical records
and the repair estimate for the pickup and can provide them on request.

"policy_numbers" = only values labeled as a policy number. A claim number is not a policy number.
"street" and "city" = the person's own home address, only if the page gives it. Never use the
address of a clinic, shop, firm or court for a person.
"loss_dates" = only a date that the page clearly gives as the date of the accident, crash, loss or
injury. Do not list the date of a note, letter, report, visit, statement, filing or signature.
"words_before" = the words written on the page directly before that date, copied exactly, that say
it is the loss date. Examples: "Date of loss:", "Crash date:", "Date of injury:", "the collision on".
